name: Analytic Derivatives of PlenOctree Rendering
aliases: NeRF Piecewise Constant Volume Rendering Derivatives
definition: Derivation of analytic derivatives of the NeRF piecewise constant volume rendering model with respect to density ($ oldsymbol{	au}$) and color ($ oldsymbol{c}$) for optimizing PlenOctrees directly.
summary: Analytic Derivatives of PlenOctree Rendering provides closed-form gradients for NeRF piecewise constant volume rendering, enabling direct gradient-based optimization of PlenOctree density and color parameters.
